purpose: Bounded evidence-enrichment observations for measured REVIEW cases. A patch is permitted only for a field explicitly supported by a declared source; ambiguity observations intentionally make no identity mutation.

observations.rationale: The retained Toyota official release explicitly describes the unveiled Corolla models as sedans and separately states hybrid availability. Re-extracting body style closes an extraction omission without changing resolver policy.
The Ford technical specification lists both Mustang GT and Mustang Dark Horse as distinct 5.0-litre V8 configurations. The missing variant cannot be guessed from the shared engine and coupe evidence.
The retained Porsche evidence distinguishes 911 generation and Carrera variants; a generic Carrera label is not evidence that the record is Carrera 4S.
